biography_summary: 陈雷蒙（Raymond Chun），1969年8月出生于韩国首尔，幼年（约4岁）随家人移民加拿大，现为加拿大籍银行高管，现任多伦多道明银行（TD Bank Group）集团总裁兼首席执行官，是首位领导加拿大五大银行之一的韩裔加拿大人。Chun拥有韦仕敦大学（University of Western Ontario）文学学士学位和女王大学（Queen's University）工商管理硕士学位。他于1992年通过管理培训生项目加入TD银行，此后三十余年始终在TD服务，是名副其实的'TD终身人'。在长达三十多年的职业生涯中，Chun先后在银行多个核心业务领域担任要职，包括TD Direct Investing总裁、TD保险总裁兼CEO、财富管理和TD保险集团负责人、加拿大个人银行业务集团负责人等。2024年9月，TD董事会宣布Chun将接替退休的Bharat Masrani担任CEO，他先于2024年11月被任命为首席运营官，随后于2025年2月1日提前正式接任集团总裁兼CEO。Chun上任后迅速推动银行战略转型，提出'深化客户关系、更简单更快、纪律性执行'三大战略支柱，推出'更人性化'（More Human）品牌定位，大力投资AI和数字化转型，同时着力解决美国反洗钱合规问题。在他的领导下，TD 2025财年收入增长9%至618亿加元，2026年第一季度创下超42亿加元的历史新高盈利记录。Chun热心社区公益事业和韩裔加拿大人事务，曾于2016年获韩裔加拿大人奖学金基金会颁发的'梦想树奖'，并担任多伦多贸易委员会董事和交通拥堵任务force管理委员会成员。他与妻子Karen居住在安大略省奥克维尔，育有一子一女。

collection_meta.notes: Profile of Raymond Chun, Group President and CEO of TD Bank Group. Born August 1969 in Seoul, South Korea (per biographypoints.com); moved to Canada at age 4. Korean-Canadian. Age 55 as of September 2024 (per Financial Post). Education: BA from University of Western Ontario; MBA from Queen's University. Joined TD in 1992 via management training program. Career trajectory: various roles in product, distribution, direct channels, CX, data/analytics -> President TD Direct Investing (until 2018) -> President and CEO TD Insurance (2019-2021) -> Group Head Wealth Management and TD Insurance (2021-2023) -> Group Head Canadian Personal Banking (Dec 2023 - Oct 2024) -> COO (Nov 2024 - Jan 2025) -> Group President and CEO (Feb 1, 2025). Board director of TD Bank Group since Feb 2025. First Korean-Canadian CEO of a Canadian Big Five bank. Succeeded Bharat Masrani. Key context: took over during US AML compliance crisis (TD pleaded guilty to AML violations in Oct 2024, paid ~US$3B in fines). Strategy: Deeper Relationships, Simpler and Faster, Disciplined Execution. Brand: More Human. Strong 2025/2026 results under his leadership. Community: Dream Tree Award from Korean Canadian Scholarship Foundation (2016); Toronto Region Board of Trade board member; Interac/Acxsys board member (pre-2018 merger). Wife: Karen Chun. Two grown children (son and daughter, both in university). Home: Oakville, Ontario. Self-described introvert. Estimated annual compensation ~C$12M. No Wikipedia page. No Wikidata QID.
